proposed_widenings.name: modify_carrying_capacity
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait changes carrying-capacity math by treating the bearer as one size larger, but the current surface has no carrying-capacity or effective-size-for-capacity effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity."

notes: Typecheck and tracer both passed for the Grappled-escape advantage. The carrying-capacity rider is omitted from the authored content and recorded as a widening.
